# Atlas Architecture Center - (current)

> The Atlas Architecture Center provides guidance for building a robust data platform on Atlas, covering security, automation, governance, and Well-Architected Framework best practices.

- [Guidance for Atlas Auditing and Logging](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auditing-logging.md)
- [Guidance for Atlas Auditing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auditing.md): Learn to configure database auditing in MongoDB Atlas, create custom JSON audit filters to track system events, and automate setup with Atlas CLI or Terraform.
- [Guidance for Atlas Authorization and Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth.md)
- [Authorization and Authentication Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/auth-examples.md)
- [Guidance for Atlas Authentication](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/authentication.md): Learn about the different authentication mechanisms that Atlas supports.
- [Guidance for Atlas Authorization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/authorization.md)
- [Guidance for Atlas Automated Infrastructure Provisioning](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/automation.md): Learn about the different Atlas tools to automate the provisioning and management of Atlas clusters and projects.
- [Guidance for Atlas Backups](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/backups.md): Learn the best practices for configuring backups for you Atlas cluster.
- [Features for Atlas Billing Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md): Learn about ways to manage and view your billing data.
- [Guidance for Atlas Business Continuity Planning](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/business-continuity-planning.md): Learn how to build a MongoDB Atlas business continuity plan using high availability architecture, disaster recovery procedures, testing, and documentation.
- [Features for Compliance with External Standards](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/compliance.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas meets compliance and regulation controls.
- [DORA Compliance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/compliance/dora.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas meets DORA compliance and regulation controls.
- [GDPR Compliance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/compliance/gdpr.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas meets GDPR compliance and regulation controls.
- [HIPAA Compliance](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/compliance/hipaa.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas meets HIPAA compliance and regulation controls.

Get recommendations on cost-saving configurations, billing data tools, and resource management for MongoDB Atlas.

- [Guidance for Atlas Data Encryption](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/data-encryption.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas protects data with encryption in transit via TLS, at rest using AES-256 and customer-managed keys, and in use with CSFLE and Queryable Encryption.
